blocks.text: Periodic table ke Group 17 ya VIIA ke elements ko halogens kehte hain. Is mein fluorine (F), chlorine (Cl), bromine (Br), iodine (I), astatine (At) aur tennessine (Ts) shamil hain. Halogens bohat reactive (jaldi react karne wale) non-metals ka group hain, aur in ki chemical properties (react karne ke tareeqe) aapas mein kaafi milti julti hain. Pehle chaar elements halogen family ke aam elements hain, lekin aakhri do, astatine (At) aur tennessine (Ts), bohat rare (kam milne wale) aur radioactive hain.

Halogens har phase (gas, liquid ya solid) mein diatomic molecules (do atoms wale molecules) ki shakal mein hote hain. Room temperature aur pressure par fluorine (F₂) pale yellow (halke peele) rang ki aur chlorine (Cl₂) greenish yellow (sabzi-mail peele) rang ki gas hai. Bromine (Br₂) room temperature par reddish-brown (laal-bhoore) rang ki volatile (jaldi bhaap banne wali) liquid hai; is ke dhuen corrosive (cheezon ko kha jane wale) aur toxic (zehreele) hain. Iodine (I₂) room temperature par chamakdar, slate jaisa kala solid hai. Yeh garam karne par liquid bane baghair seedha violet (jamni) bhaap ban jati hai; ise sublimation kehte hain. Chlorine se iodine tak halogens (X₂) ka rang aahista aahista gehra hota jata hai. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke har halogen ke molecule ke andar electrons ek energy level se doosre par jump karte hain (electron transitions), aur is mein roshni ka jo hissa absorb (jazb) hota hai woh har halogen mein different (alag) hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Lafz halogen Greek alfaaz “halos” (namak, salt) aur “gen” (banana) se bana hai, yani “namak banane wala”. Sab se pehle jis halogen ko alag kar ke element mana gaya woh chlorine thi. Chlorine poisonous (zehreeli) hai, phir bhi chloride ki shakal mein is ki thori amount (miqdar) insani sehat aur zindagi ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Table ko oopar se neeche parhein: group mein neeche jate hue proton number, shells aur atomic mass barhte hain. Is ke saath melting aur boiling points bhi barhte hain, is liye F₂ aur Cl₂ gas, Br₂ liquid aur I₂ solid hai. Sab ke bahar wale shell mein 7 electrons (ns²np⁵) hain; isi liye in ki chemistry milti julti hai.

blocks.prompt: Table 13.1 dekh kar batayein: kaun sa halogen room temperature par liquid hai, aur sab halogens ke bahar wale shell mein kitne electrons hain?
blocks.explanation: Bromine liquid hai (melting point –7 ºC aur boiling point 59 ºC, yani 20 ºC is ke darmiyan hai). Har halogen ke bahar wale shell mein 7 electrons hain (ns²np⁵), maslan chlorine 3s²3p⁵.

items: Group 17 (VIIA) ke elements halogens hain: F, Cl, Br, I aam hain; At aur Ts rare aur radioactive hain.
Halogens diatomic (X₂) hain. F₂ halki peeli gas, Cl₂ greenish yellow gas, Br₂ reddish-brown liquid, I₂ kala solid jo violet bhaap mein sublime hota hai.
Rang chlorine se iodine tak gehra hota hai (electron transitions se roshni ka absorb hona).
